description: For a builder, plumber, electrician or other trade: the VAT on one building job and who pays it (the domestic reverse charge), what CIS takes off, what is paid to them, and what they keep on standard VAT against the Flat Rate Scheme, plus whether their sales mean they must register for VAT. Use for 'do I charge VAT to this builder?' or 'what will I take home from this job after CIS?'.

cisRegistered.description: True if they are registered for CIS (20% taken off), false for 30%. Defaults to true.

customer.description: Who the job is for: a homeowner or business not VAT-registered, a VAT-registered builder under CIS, or a VAT-registered builder who is the end user. Defaults to homeowner.

firstYear.description: True in their first year of VAT registration: 1% off the flat rate. Defaults to false.

flatRatePct.description: Their Flat Rate Scheme percentage. Defaults to 9.5, general building.

labour.description: Their charge for the work, before VAT, in pounds.

materials.description: What they charge the customer for materials, before VAT, in pounds. Defaults to 0.

materialsCost.description: What the materials cost them, before VAT, in pounds. Defaults to what's on the bill.

salesLast12Months.description: Their sales over the last 12 months, materials included, before VAT, in pounds. Optional, for the registration check.

vatRatePct.description: The job's VAT rate: 20 for most work on existing homes, 5 for conversions and homes empty 2 years or more, 0 for new homes and energy-saving fitting. Defaults to 20.

vatRegistered.description: True if they are VAT-registered. Defaults to true.

name: calculate_trade_vat
title: VAT and CIS for trades
